Timelines and milestones

12 guides

Understanding Your Menstrual Cycle and Fertile Window

Learn how the menstrual cycle works, when ovulation happens, and how to identify your fertile window so you can time intercourse for the best chance of conceiving.

How to Track Ovulation: Temperature, Mucus, and Kits

Three reliable ways to track ovulation (basal body temperature, cervical mucus, and ovulation predictor kits) and how to combine them to find your most fertile days.

Signs of Ovulation: How to Tell When You Ovulate

Learn the common signs of ovulation, which ones appear early enough to help you time sex, and which ones only confirm that an egg has already been released.

How to Use Ovulation Tests and Read the Results

Learn how to use ovulation tests: when to start testing, the best time of day, how to read faint lines, and what a positive means for timing.

Cervical Mucus Stages: What Fertile Mucus Looks Like

A plain guide to cervical mucus stages across one cycle, what fertile egg white mucus looks like, how to check it daily, and which changes need a clinician instead of a chart.

Early Pregnancy Signs Before a Missed Period

Early pregnancy signs before a missed period can include fatigue, swollen breasts, light spotting, and smell changes. Learn what they mean and when to test.

When to Take a Pregnancy Test for an Accurate Result

Learn when to take a pregnancy test for a reliable result, why testing too early causes false negatives, and what faint lines and negative results really mean.

PCOS and Ovulation Tracking: Use Data Without Letting It Take Over

How to track ovulation with PCOS more thoughtfully, understand the limits of apps and tests, record useful patterns, and know when to ask for clinical support.

Coping With a Negative Pregnancy Test

A compassionate, practical guide to what a negative test can mean, when to retest, how to care for yourself, and how to decide on the next step without self-blame.

A Low-Stress Cycle Planning Routine, Week by Week

A simple cycle-planning routine for noticing periods, preparing for the fertile window, timing intimacy, and reviewing patterns without turning every day into a fertility test.

Implantation: When It Happens and What You Might Notice

When does implantation occur? Usually 6 to 12 days after ovulation, most often 8 to 10. Learn how implantation bleeding differs from a period and when a test can turn positive.

The Luteal Phase: Length, Symptoms, and Why It Matters

What the luteal phase is, how long it lasts, why its symptoms mirror early pregnancy, and when a short luteal phase deserves a conversation with your clinician.

Preconception Health: How to Prepare Your Body for Pregnancy

A practical preconception checklist (nutrition, prenatal vitamins, health checks, lifestyle changes, and when to start) to give your future pregnancy the healthiest possible start.

Folic Acid and Prenatal Vitamins Before Pregnancy

Why folic acid matters before and during early pregnancy, how much you may need, food sources, and what to look for in a preconception prenatal vitamin.

Foods and Habits That Support Fertility

There is no magic fertility diet, but everyday nutrition and lifestyle habits can support hormonal balance and reproductive health for both partners.

Coming Off Birth Control: What to Expect

How fertility returns after stopping different contraceptives, how soon you can try to conceive, and what changes to expect in your cycle.

When to Start Prenatal Vitamins Before Pregnancy

Start prenatal vitamins at least one month before trying to conceive, ideally three. Here is when to start prenatal vitamins and how to read the label before you buy.

Folic Acid Before Pregnancy: How Much and When to Start

How much folic acid before pregnancy, when to start, folate versus folic acid, who needs the 4 mg prescription dose, and the best food sources of folate, explained calmly.

What to Eat When Trying to Get Pregnant: Fertility Nutrition

A calm, evidence-based guide to what to eat when trying to get pregnant: the food patterns linked to fertility, key nutrients like folate and iron, and the myths you can skip.

Caffeine and Alcohol While Trying to Conceive

Most clinicians suggest keeping caffeine under about 200 mg a day and stopping alcohol while trying to conceive. Here is what that looks like in real cups and real weeks.

Preconception Appointment: What to Expect and Ask

A preconception appointment is a short visit that reviews your health, medicines, vaccines, and tests before pregnancy. Here is what to expect and what to ask.

A Practical Medication Review Before Pregnancy

How to make a safe, useful list of medicines and supplements before pregnancy, what to ask at a preconception visit, and why you should not stop prescribed treatment on your own.

What to Expect When Fertility Returns After Birth Control

The Shettles Method: Can Timing Influence Your Baby’s Sex?

Boosting Male Fertility: Sperm Health Basics

How Long Does It Usually Take to Get Pregnant?

How long conception typically takes, what affects the timeline, why it is normal for it to take several months, and when it makes sense to seek help.

When to See a Fertility Specialist

How to Improve Sperm Quality: A Partner Health Checklist

How to Get Pregnant With Irregular Periods

How to get pregnant with irregular periods: what counts as irregular, why day 14 advice fails, tracking that still works, and a simple timing plan that does not depend on prediction.

When to Seek Fertility Help: 6 and 12 Month Guidelines

Protecting Your Emotional Wellbeing While Trying to Conceive

A grounded guide to managing the emotional load of trying to conceive, setting boundaries, staying connected with a partner, and recognizing when extra support would help.

Endometriosis and Conception: A More Informed Starting Point
